title: Final Report - Fine Tuning Methods for Low-resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative evaluation of the model's performance in an underrepresented language (Swedish) compared to English, using standard NLP metrics for question answering, summarization, and text generation (EM, F1, ROUGE, BLEU, METEOR, BERTScore, and COMET).

Qualitative and subjective evaluation by native speakers to assess responses for cultural authenticity, historical relevance, and factual accuracy regarding local traditions and societal structures (e.g., evaluating whether the model hallucinated American-centric concepts like a 'president' for Sweden instead of culturally accurate facts).
